purpose: Requirements for formal references by DLID, link checks, path correction info, section references, change impact candidate notification, and consistency checks with detail file output.
summary: FR-007 formal reference notation: reference link definition title holds content hash and DLID
FR-009 link checks by searching the specified directories, with anchor resolution rules
FR-010 path correction info, including searching the current Index target list for moved documents
Section ID rules: DLID at the end of every heading and section range definition
FR-013 and FR-014 change impact candidates found by comparing recorded hash and current hash, direct references only
FR-015 no notification state is stored; the same references are reported until the project management AI updates the recorded hash
FR-016 list of inconsistencies to detect, and user confirmation before rewriting documents
Check results return counts on stdout and full details in a work file, even with zero findings
doc-link never writes references or modifies Index target documents
Acceptance criteria AC-003, AC-004, AC-006 to AC-009, AC-028, AC-032 to AC-035
tasks: Implementing link checks and reference extraction
Implementing consistency checks such as check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact
Writing reference links and recording hashes in link titles
Handling moved or renamed documents and path mismatches
Designing section ID and anchor handling
Designing detail file output of check results
Reviewing reference requirements and acceptance criteria
